stem_book: Passage (Q6 & Q7): A monkey of mass m clings to a rope hanging over a fixed pulley at the edge of a horizontal table. The opposite end of the rope is tied to a weight of mass M lying on the table. The coefficient of friction between the weight and the table is μ. The monkey moves downwards w.r.t. the rope with an acceleration b. Q7. The tension of the rope is (a) Mm(μg + g + b)/(M + m) (b) Mm(μg − g + b)/(M + m) (c) Mm(μg + g − b)/(M + m) (d) Mm(μg − g − b)/(M + m)
